description: This file defines a React component named UsersList, which displays a list of users in a table with filtering, searching, and optional actions. It manages state for user data, filters, loading/error states, and handles data fetching from an API endpoint. The component is designed to be reusable and configurable via props.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches all users data from the API and updates the component state.

methods.name: resetFilters
methods.description: Resets search query and organization filter to show all users.

methods.name: handleRowClick
methods.description: Handles row click events, delegating to parent callbacks.
